title: Build a Multi-Section Website with AI Component Generation
description: Use v0.dev or Claude to generate individual components, then assemble them into a complete website
objective: Students will use AI tools to generate individual website components (navbar, hero, cards, FAQ, footer), review and customize each one, assemble into a complete page, and document their AI-assisted workflow

steps.title: Plan Your Website Sections
steps.instructions:
Before using any AI tool, plan your website on paper:

**Business:** Choose a local business (restaurant, gym, salon, clinic, tuition center)

**Sections needed:**
1. Navbar with logo and links
2. Hero with heading and CTA
3. Services/Features (4 cards)
4. About section
5. FAQ (accordion)
6. Contact with form
7. Footer

For each section, write a one-line description of what it should contain.

Create a file `plan.md` with your section plan.

steps.title: Generate Components One by One
steps.instructions:
Instead of generating the entire page at once, generate each section separately. This gives you more control.

**Prompt for Navbar:**
```
Create a responsive navbar using HTML + Tailwind CSS for a [YOUR BUSINESS]. 
Include: logo text on left, 4 nav links on right, mobile hamburger menu. 
Fixed position, white background with shadow.
```

**Prompt for Hero:**
```
Create a hero section for [YOUR BUSINESS] using Tailwind CSS. 
Include: large heading, subtitle, two buttons (primary CTA + secondary), 
and a background gradient. Centered text.
```

**Prompt for FAQ:**
```
Create an FAQ accordion section using HTML + Tailwind CSS + vanilla JavaScript. 
5 questions about [YOUR BUSINESS]. Click to expand/collapse. 
Only one answer visible at a time.
```

For each section:
1. Paste the AI output into a temporary HTML file
2. Open with Live Server to preview
3. Modify colors, text, and spacing
4. Copy the working section into your main `index.html`

steps.title: Assemble and Customize
steps.instructions:
Create your main `index.html` with the Tailwind CDN and paste all sections in order.

Now customize beyond what AI generated:

1. **Consistent color scheme** — make sure all sections use the same primary color
2. **Spacing** — add consistent `py-20 px-4` to each section
3. **Alternate backgrounds** — use `bg-white` and `bg-gray-50` alternately
4. **Add transitions** — `transition hover:-translate-y-1 hover:shadow-lg` on cards
5. **Test mobile** — open DevTools (F12) → device mode → check each section

Fix any issues:
- Text too small on mobile? Increase `text-base` or remove extra small sizes
- Images overflowing? Add `max-w-full` or `w-full`
- Navbar overlapping content? Make sure first section has `pt-20` padding

steps.title: Document and Deploy
steps.instructions:
Create a `PROCESS.md` file documenting your workflow:

```markdown
# AI-Assisted Website — Process Document

## Business: [Name]

## Tools Used
- AI Tool: [Claude / ChatGPT / v0.dev]
- Editor: VS Code
- Deployment: GitHub Pages

## Section-by-Section

### 1. Navbar
- **AI Prompt:** [paste your prompt]
- **AI Output:** [worked / needed fixes]
- **Manual Changes:** [what you changed]

### 2. Hero
- **AI Prompt:** ...
...

## What I Learned
- [What AI did well]
- [What AI got wrong]
- [What I had to fix manually]
```

Deploy to GitHub Pages:
```bash
git init
git add .
git commit -m "AI-assisted business website"
git remote add origin [your-repo-url]
git push -u origin main
```

Enable GitHub Pages in Settings.

**Submit:** GitHub repo link + live URL + PROCESS.md document.

steps.title: Test Responsiveness and Fix Issues
steps.instructions:
Open Chrome DevTools (F12) → click the **device toggle** icon (Ctrl+Shift+M).

Test on these devices:

| Device | Width | Check |
|--------|-------|-------|
| iPhone SE | 375px | All sections stack, text readable, no overflow |
| iPad | 768px | 2-column layouts where appropriate |
| Desktop | 1280px | Full layout, proper spacing |

Common mobile issues to fix:
- Text overflowing the screen → add `overflow-x: hidden` to body or use `max-w-full`
- Images too wide → add `max-w-full` or `w-full`
- Buttons too small to tap → make at least `py-3 px-6` on mobile
- Navbar links not visible → add a hamburger menu or stack links vertically
- Font too small → use at least `text-base` (16px) for body text

Also test:
- Does smooth scrolling work on all links?
- Does the contact form fit on mobile?
- Are all images loading?

Fix any issues, commit, push, and verify on the live URL from your phone.

**Final Submit:** GitHub repo + live URL + PROCESS.md + mobile screenshot from your actual phone.

expected_output: A complete multi-section website assembled from AI-generated components, with manual customizations, responsive design, and a documented process showing the AI prompts used and changes made
